jobs.occupation: Junior Product Manager (f-m-d) Outdoor Power Equipment Milwaukee® (Produktmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Job Description: Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in
cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools,
outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. Our
focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the industrial,
construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement,
repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio includes
MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® - recognized worldwide for their deep
heritage and innovative product platforms of superior quality. The
company maintains a global manufacturing and product development
footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately US$15.2
billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring exceptional people
is a top focus at TTI. This drives a high-performance culture across
all levels of our organization and helps to achieve our vision of
being number one in the industries we serve. Our unique high-speed
decision-making process supports our acute focus on developing
superior products and meeting high customer expectations. We view our
winning culture as a competitive advantage that powers our growth. To
strengthen our team in Winnenden (Stuttgart area) as soon as possible,
we are looking for a Junior Product Manager (f-m-d) Outdoor Power
Equipment Milwaukee® Key Responsibilities: International customer
visits and definition of product requirements for the European market
Overseeing product development from concept to mass production of the
outdoor power equipment Life cycle management of Milwaukee® products
Responsible for product marketing and development of sales strategy
Manage product launches in terms of production dates, product details,
and availability in European warehouses, pan-European price
positioning and local market pricing and monitoring Present products
at large and small customer groups and events in key EMEA markets
Provide product training and support to our European distributors and
international salespeople on specific product issues Liaise with
global development teams Create promotional and marketing materials in
collaboration with other departments Requirements: Bachelor’s degree
or equivalent technical education Relevant professional experience as
a product manager in the power tool or OPE industry as an advantage
Good knowledge of English; know-how of an additional foreign language
is an advantage Willingness to travel as required by business needs
(approx. 20%) Your perks: An interesting position with an attractive
company – recognized as a "top employer” by kununu Company pension
scheme Free parking spaces directly next to the office and good public
transport connections Fresh fruit, water and hot beverages for free
Company fitness via "EGYM Wellpass" Bicycle leasing via "JobRad” EAP
(mental support for employees) Learning platforms such as "GoodHabitz"
and "Learn TTI" for your professional development Special employee
benefits via "Family & Friends" and additional corporate benefits Are
you interested? If you like wild growth and working with happy,
enthusiastic over-achievers, you will enjoy your career with us! Send
your application stating your earliest possible starting date and your
salary expectations directly via our careers page . Naturally, we will
treat your application with the utmost discretion. We look forward to
getting to know you! Techtronic Industries ELC GmbH Human Resources
– Agnese Cesarini · Max-Eyth-Straße 10 · 71364 Winnenden
www.ttigroup.com/careers/global-career-opportunities

Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. The Role We are seeking a proactive,
detail-oriented and experienced Senior HR Manager (m/f/d) to join our
team in Berlin. This role will be responsible for leading key people,
compliance, and governance activities across the employee lifecycle,
ensuring that HR practices are legally compliant, operationally
effective, and aligned with organisational objectives. Acting as a
trusted advisor to managers and employees, the role provides expert
guidance on employment and employee relations matters, oversees HR
compliance and audit readiness, and drives continuous improvement of
HR policies and processes. The role also leads Health, Safety &
Environment (HSE) initiatives, ensuring compliance with German and
European regulations while promoting a safe, healthy, and engaging
workplace. Working closely with internal stakeholders, external
partners, and legal advisors, the Senior HR Manager identifies and
mitigates people-related risks, maintains strong governance
frameworks, and contributes to a positive employee experience across
the organisation. This position is ideal for an experienced HR
professional who enjoys combining hands-on operational work with
compliance oversight and strategic enhancement of HR practices. Key
Responsibilities Employment & Employee Relations Support managers on
employment-related matters and people management practices. Draft and
review employment contracts, amendments, and employment documentation.
Ensure compliance with German labor law and collective agreements
where applicable. Manage employee relations cases, including
disciplinary procedures, grievances, performance-related matters, and
workplace concerns. Partner with external legal advisors when
required. Compliance, Audits & Risk Management Conduct regular
internal HR audits to ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and
company requirements. Maintain audit-ready documentation and records.
Identify compliance risks and implement corrective actions. Support
external audits and inspections related to employment, payroll, HR
processes, and workplace regulations. Monitor and communicate changes
in employment legislation and HR compliance requirements. EU Health,
Safety & Environment Lead and coordinate health and safety initiatives
in accordance with German and European regulations. Ensure compliance
with occupational health and safety requirements. Partner with
internal stakeholders and external providers to maintain safe working
environments. Coordinate risk assessments, workplace inspections, and
mandatory training. Support wellbeing initiatives that promote
employee health and engagement. Policies, Governance & Process
Improvement Review, maintain and develop HR policies, procedures, and
employee handbook content. Ensure policies are legally compliant,
practical, and consistently applied across the organization. Drive
continuous improvement initiatives across HR operations and employee
experience. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human
Resources, Business Administration, Law, Psychology, or a related
field. 5+ years of progressive HR experience in a generalist or HR
operations-focused role. Strong knowledge of German labour law,
employment regulations, and HR compliance requirements. Experience
managing payroll processes and working with payroll providers. Proven
experience conducting HR audits and implementing compliance
initiatives. Knowledge of occupational health and safety requirements
in Germany. Experience developing and maintaining HR policies and
procedures. Strong understanding of HRIS systems and HR data
management. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken.
HSE certification preferred; candidates without formal qualifications
must demonstrate a willingness to complete HSE training Preferred
Qualifications Professional HR certification or relevant HR
qualification. Experience in an international or fast-growing
organization. Previous involvement in HR transformation, process
improvement, or digitalization projects. Experience working with audit
frameworks, compliance reviews, and risk management processes. Key
Competencies Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential
information. Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Ability to balance operational execution with strategic thinking.
Process-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
Strong project management and organisational skills. Collaborative and
customer-focused approach. What We Offer Opportunity to shape and
improve HR operations in a dynamic environment. Collaborative and
international team culture. Professional development and learning
opportunities. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Flexible
working arrangements. A people-first workplace focused on inclusion,
wellbeing, and growth. Equal Opportunity Statement We celebrate
diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for
all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all
backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and are dedicated to

Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. The Role We are seeking an
experienced Head of Academies (m/f/d) to provide operational
leadership for the European Raw Materials Academy and the European
Advanced Materials Academy. The European Raw Materials Academy and the
European Advanced Materials Academy are flagship European initiatives
that develop the skills and talent needed to strengthen Europe’s
competitiveness and industrial transformation in the raw and advanced
materials sectors. Reporting to the Director of Education & Skills,
the Head of Academies is responsible for translating strategic
priorities into operational delivery and ensuring the successful
implementation, scaling, and continuous improvement of both Academies.
The Head of Academies (m/f/d) provides direct line management to three
Senior Education Managers who collectively lead a multidisciplinary
team of approximately 20 colleagues. The ideal candidate combines
operational excellence with an entrepreneurial mindset and a proven
ability to scale digital education initiatives. Success will be
measured through learner growth, program quality, operational
performance, and delivery against agreed Academy KPIs. Key
Accountabilities The Head of Academies is accountable for: 1.
Operational Delivery • Translate strategic priorities into
operational plans and ensure successful delivery against agreed
objectives, KPIs, timelines, budgets, quality standards, and
compliance requirements. • Establish and maintain effective
operational processes, governance, reporting, and continuous
improvement across both Academies. 2. Education Portfolio & Digital
Learning Platforms • Lead the operational management and continuous
improvement of the Academies' digital learning ecosystem, providing
recommendations to support strategic decision-making. • Drive
learner growth, program quality, and an excellent learner experience
through effective operational management and data-informed
decision-making. 3. Team Leadership • Lead, coach, and support the
Senior Managers responsible for Operations, Course Development, and
Partnerships. • Foster a high-performing, collaborative, and
accountable multidisciplinary team. 4. Operational Performance &
Resources • Manage operational budgets within agreed frameworks,
supplier relationships, and procurement activities to support the
successful delivery of both Academies and ensure efficient and
compliant use of resources. • Develop, monitor, and report on
Academy KPIs, analyse operational performance, identify risks and
opportunities, and recommend continuous improvement initiatives. 5.
Stakeholder Collaboration • Maintain productive relationships with
internal teams and other key stakeholders to ensure alignment,
successful delivery, and sustainable growth of both Academies. What
We’re Looking For Required • Experience leading professional
learning, education, or workforce development programs. • Proven
success scaling digital education, EdTech, or professional learning
initiatives. • Operational leadership and program management
experience, including digital learning platforms and Learning
Management Systems. • Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary
teams and delivering against ambitious KPIs and operational
objectives. • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder
management skills. • Excellent written and spoken English. Desirable
• Background in EdTech, professional education, or corporate
learning and development. • Experience building or scaling education
academies, digital learning platforms, or comparable education
initiatives. • Familiarity with EU-funded projects, Horizon Europe,
Erasmus+, or the EIT ecosystem. • Understanding of quality
assurance, certification, credentials, and micro-credentials. •
Working knowledge of additional European languages. What We Offer •
The opportunity to lead the operational scaling of two flagship
European Academies with significant strategic impact. • Join a
committed, mission-driven team working at the intersection of
education, innovation, industry, and European policy. • Work with
leading European universities, industry partners, and public-sector
organisations to help shape the future workforce for the raw and
advanced materials sectors. • Hybrid working environment in Berlin.
• Competitive salary. Position Details • Location: Berlin,
Germany. • Contract: Full-time. • Duration: Fixed-term contract
until 2029, with the possibility of extension. • Travel: Occasional
travel within Europe is required. • Reports to: Director of
Education & Skills, EIT RawMaterials. Commitment to Diversity: EIT
RawMaterials is committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage
applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of background.

As an (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) at Siemens Advanta’s Strategy and Innovation Practice, you will serve as a senior leader overseeing pivotal domains: Delivery, Business Development, and People & Capability Building. - Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.

With a focus on high-speed PCB layout for embedded and FPGA-based systems, you will develop sophisticated hardware platforms for the professional audio and video broadcast industry while working closely with our in-house production team.

- Experience with SI and PI simulation tools (e.g., Ansys SIwave and AEDT/HFSS, or equivalent)

- Experience collaborating closely with manufacturing and production teams is highly desirable
- Knowledge of broadcast, video, or professional audio systems is an advantage

At Mendix, a Siemens business, we are redefining how enterprises build, deploy and scale intelligent applications. As the leading low-code platform, Mendix empowers organizations to accelerate digital transformation by combining software development, AI and enterprise collaboration.
With the introduction of Intelligence Center X, Siemens is entering the next generation of Industrial AI. Intelligence Center X combines enterprise data, AI agents, knowledge graphs and intelligent applications into a secure and governed ecosystem that enables organizations to move from isolated AI initiatives to enterprise-wide transformation.
To accelerate this vision across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, we are looking for an experienced Regional Enterprise Sales Director Industrial AI Transformation DACH.
This executive leadership role combines commercial leadership, strategic market development and executive customer engagement. You will be responsible for scaling the Mendix business while establishing Intelligence Center X as the leading Industrial AI platform for enterprise customers across the region.
Your Mission
You will own the commercial strategy, market expansion and business performance for Mendix and Intelligence Center X across DACH.
Working closely with Siemens Digital Industries Software, Siemens Xcelerator, Partner Sales, Customer Success, Product Management and Services, you will build one of Siemens' fastest growing software businesses.

Industrial AI Market Development

- Position Intelligence Center X as the strategic Industrial AI platform for enterprise customers.- Help customers evolve from isolated AI pilots toward enterprise-wide AI transformation.- Drive executive conversations around AI, Digital Engineering, Digital Manufacturing, Digital Thread and Enterprise Transformation.- Develop strategic industry plays and AI transformation programs for Manufacturing, Automotive, Energy, Life Sciences, Infrastructure and Process Industries.- Expand Mendix as the preferred platform for intelligent applications, AI copilots and agent-based business processes.

Executive Customer Engagement

- Build trusted relationships with CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, Chief Digital Officers and business executives.- Support strategic enterprise opportunities through executive sponsorship and value-based selling.- Participate directly in key customer engagements and complex negotiations.- Position Siemens as a strategic transformation partner beyond traditional software sales.

Ecosystem Leadership

- Collaborate across Siemens Digital Industries Software, Siemens Xcelerator, AI Studio, Graph Studio and Partner organizations.- Build strong relationships with Global System Integrators, consulting partners and technology alliances.- Develop joint go-to-market initiatives that accelerate Industrial AI adoption.- Represent Mendix and Intelligence Center X at executive events, customer forums and industry conferences.

Intelligence-Driven Business Management

- Leverage customer, market and competitive intelligence to identify growth opportunities.- Build executive dashboards and business insights to improve forecasting, pipeline health and commercial performance.- Translate customer feedback into product innovation together with Product Management.- Establish scalable sales methodologies, industry playbooks and best practices across the region.

Leadership & Culture

- Inspire, coach and develop diverse, high-performing teams.- Foster an inclusive, collaborative and customer-centric culture.- Encourage innovation, continuous learning and experimentation.- Build future sales leaders capable of driving the next generation of Industrial AI transformation.

What You'll Bring:- Extensive executive sales leadership experience within Enterprise Software, SaaS or Industrial Software.- Proven success building and scaling high-growth enterprise businesses across the DACH region.- Strong experience leading second-line sales organizations.- Track record of exceeding revenue targets while developing high-performing commercial teams.- Experience engaging C-level executives on strategic transformation initiatives.- Deep understanding of Digital Transformation, AI, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Platforms or Industrial Software.- Strong analytical capabilities with experience leveraging business intelligence and data-driven decision making.- Experience working within complex matrix organizations and global ecosystems.- Outstanding executive communication, presentation and negotiation skills.- Fluent German and English.

Preferred Experience:- Industrial AI- Low-Code / No-Code Platforms- Enterprise Applications- Manufacturing Digitalization- Siemens Xcelerator Ecosystem- AI Governance- Enterprise Architecture- Platform Business Models- Digital Engineering- Digital Manufacturing- Agentic AI- Knowledge Graphs- Enterprise Data Platforms

- Significantly accelerated Mendix growth across DACH.- Established Intelligence Center X as a strategic Industrial AI platform within key enterprise accounts.- Built one of the highest-performing enterprise software organizations within Siemens.- Expanded strategic relationships with executive customers and partners.- Created a scalable commercial operating model supporting long-term double-digit growth.- Positioned Mendix as the application platform connecting AI, enterprise data and business processes across the Siemens Xcelerator ecosystem.

Why Join Us?
This is more than a regional sales leadership position.
It is an opportunity to shape how Industrial AI is adopted across Europe's largest industrial economy. You will influence executive transformation agendas, build the next generation of enterprise software growth and help define the future of intelligent enterprises together with Siemens and Mendix.
If you are passionate about combining commercial excellence, transformational leadership and Industrial AI innovation, we invite you to join us in building the future.

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. What you'll build:

SAP SS&D (Sovereign Services & Delivery) is looking for an IT Risk & Compliance Specialist (f/m/d) to operate, audit, and further develop the secure infrastructure at our Walldorf location.

In this role, you will serve as the central authority for IT risk management, compliance assurance, and audit coordination within our highly secure operational environment. You will ensure risk-compliant governance of the local IT landscape — including the on-site Micro Data Center — with a strong emphasis on BSI IT-Grundschutz implementation, ISO 27001 adherence, and regulatory alignment.

Your responsibilities span strategic compliance planning and hands-on operational delivery: conducting internal and external audits, maintaining ISMS documentation, driving continuous improvement of the security and compliance posture, and ensuring all systems meet the strictest confidentiality and regulatory requirements for public sector and regulated industry customers.

You will act as a trusted advisor and liaison for compliance- and security-related matters at the Walldorf site, engaging with internal stakeholders, external auditors, and government authorities.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

- Leading IT compliance, audit, and GRC activities in accordance with BSI IT-Grundschutz, ISO 27001, and applicable regulatory requirements
- Preparing, conducting, and following up on audits, including evidence collection, remediation tracking, and coordination with auditors, certification bodies, and authorities
- Creating and maintaining audit-ready IT security and compliance documentation, including IT-Grundschutz and ISMS artefacts, security concepts, risk registers, operating procedures, meeting minutes, and workshop summaries
- Preparing and delivering presentations, management briefings, decision papers, and structured reports on technical, security, compliance, and project-related topics
- Identifying, assessing, documenting, and mitigating operational IT risks and supporting security accreditation processes for classified environments
- Operating and maintaining secure IT infrastructure, including virtualized environments, Active Directory, access controls, backup and recovery, hardened clients, and IT asset management
- Using SIEM solutions, to analyze logs, detect anomalies, and support incident response and forensic activities
- Supporting procurement processes by identifying requirements, coordinating with stakeholders and vendors, and initiating orders when required
- Acting as a central interface between collaborating departments by consolidating requirements, coordinating cross-functional topics, clarifying responsibilities, and ensuring effective information flow
- Coordinating external service providers and acting as the local contact for auditors, customers, stakeholders, and government authorities, including conducting infrastructure tours and technical walkthroughs

What you bring:

You are a committed and proactive IT Risk & Compliance Specialist with a strong background in secure infrastructure operations, regulatory frameworks, and audit management. Your profile should demonstrate experience in several of the following areas:

- Master's degree (or equivalent) in IT, cybersecurity, information security management, or a related field — alternatively, completed vocational training as an IT specialist (Fachinformatiker) with substantial relevant professional experience
- 4+ years of relevant working experience in IT risk, compliance, or secure IT operations
- Strong expertise in Governance, Risk Management & Compliance and Auditing Support — including hands-on experience with BSI IT-Grundschutz, ISO 27001, gap analyses, ISMS implementation, audit preparation, evidence management, and remediation tracking
- Solid understanding of Operational Risk Mitigation and Cyber Security — from identifying and treating IT risks systematically to working with BSI-certified products, secure IT architectures, SIEM platforms (ideally Splunk), and classified environments
- Proven Project Management skills — ability to plan and drive compliance and infrastructure projects independently, on time, and within defined governance frameworks
- Familiarity with AI tools in a professional context: experience applying AI-assisted automation and prototyping, agentic workflows, and context engineering to operational or compliance tasks — paired with a critical eye for AI output quality assurance and the ability to drive AI adoption within the team
- Strong communication and stakeholder skills — excellent written and spoken German and English, with the ability to build trust with internal teams, external auditors, and government authorities, and to translate complex regulatory topics into clear, actionable language for diverse audiences
- Emotional intelligence and customer orientation — empathetic and composed under pressure, with a genuine focus on delivering value and clarity to all stakeholders, even in sensitive or high-stakes situations
- Complex problem-solving mindset — structured and analytical, with the ability to diagnose root causes, evaluate trade-offs, and drive sustainable solutions in ambiguous environments
- A collaborative, hands-on, and solution-oriented working style with strong organizational skills

Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK
We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

You assess current systems, infrastructure, and business processes to identify improvement opportunities and ensure compatibility with new solutions

- 
You collect and analyze stakeholder requirements to define solution scope and objectives

- 
You architect the Mercedes Pay Digital Voucher Solution, detailing structure, components, interfaces, and data flows, and select suitable technologies, platforms, and tools

- 
You create proof-of-concept projects to validate solutions and demonstrate feasibility

- 
You work with an experienced team of Solution Architects as well as the company's Enterprise, Cloud and Security Architects to derive right-fit solutions

- 
You facilitate the collaboration with external development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices

- 
You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical details into accessible language

- 
You document solutions and disseminate best practices among team members

Qualifikationen

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

- 
You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field

- 
You have 5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, with a strong focus on software product development

- 
You have practical experience in at least one of the following domains: regulatory environments, agentic commerce, loyalty programs, vouchers, digital marketing, or payments (including PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, or AML/KYC)

- 
You are proficient in microservices, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, CI/CD), Auth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocols, alongside practices like Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and DevOps

- 
You have hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, GitHub, and Datadog

- 
You have a proven track record of implementing cutting-edge technologies within a corporate environment

- 
You possess strong teamwork and good communication skills, with the ability to maintain composure under pressure

- 
You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plus

OUR OFFER TO YOU

jobs.employer_name: Allied Joint Support and Enabling Command (JSEC) Ulm NATO
jobs.description:
Shape security. Work internationally.

The NATO Headquarters Allied Joint Support and Enabling Command (JSEC) in Ulm is part of one of the world's most important security alliances. In a highly international environment, our employees make an important contribution to the collective security, stability, and cooperation of the alliance partners. Civilian experts make an indispensable contribution at the international level.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a

Staff Assistant (Community Relations) (m/w/d)

What tasks will you be responsible for in particular?

• Assistance with finding temporary accommodations as well as permanent housing and support with lease agreements

• Accompaniment during apartment and house viewings, registration/deregistration and visits to government offices

• Assistance with finding daycare and schools, banking matters etc.

• Support with insurance matters, with electricity and internet providers or registering and deregistering vehicles

• Assistance with applying for government benefits, e.g., child benefit applications

• Support services for JSEC events

• Planning, preparation, and implementation of individual “Morale and Welfare” initiatives

• Assist in Civilian check-in and check-out procedures for JSEC personnel and their dependents

What should you bring with you?

• Secondary or equivalent education and vocational training in office administration or comparable.

• Proven job related knowledge acquired through at least one year job related experience

• Good appearance and a natural manner with people

• Driving license equivalent to European class B

• Experienced in using MS Office.

• Good written and oral communication skills in English and German.

• You can provide evidence of a current Sicherheitsüberprüfung (SÜ2) security clearance, or you must be willing to participate in an extended security clearance process in accordance with the Security Clearance Act. Successful completion of the security clearance is mandatory to take up duty for the advertised position.

• Citizenship from one of the 32 NATO member countries.

What do we offer?

• A job in an international and dynamic environment with a strong purpose.

• Collaboration with experts from numerous countries.

• Remuneration in accordance with the TV NATO collective agreement in conjunction with TV AL II classification C 5. Monthly base salary, before tax: 3.102,58 € (as of February 2026).

• Christmas and vacation bonuses.

• 38.5-hour working week.

• Employee canteen on site.

• Company pension scheme.

• Employee events.

Interested?

If you are interested in working in a multinational environment with strategic relevance, we look forward to receiving your application.

Please submit your complete application documents (cover letter, resume, relevant references) and mention your citizenship* to

jsec.recruiting@nato.int

* Citizenship from one of the 32 NATO member countries is required to be authorised to work for NATO.

If you have any questions, please contact

Thomas Kilbinger at 0731 –16904117

Stuttgarterstr. 199

89081 Ulm
